pages.title: biuro — one Polish word, taught properly
pages.lead: biuro: the base word, four forms, why they change, and how to use it in a sentence.

pages.title: At the office
pages.lead: Five short steps: story, spelling, forms, dialogue and matching.

parts.text: Pracuję w biurze. means I work in the office. After w, the place word takes the locative ending: the -o of biuro becomes -e and r softens to rz.
Try the sentence with another place you know before you return to the card.
biuro is written with one b, one u, one r and one o. It is neuter, so the article to match it is to, not ten or ta.

pages.title: The forms card
pages.lead: How and why the ending changes

parts.text: biura is the genitive: the -o becomes -a, and it follows do or nie ma. biuru is the dative: -o becomes -u when the office is the one you help or speak to.
biurze is the locative after w. biurem is the instrumental with -em, used for the thing you work with or manage.

pages.title: The dialogue card
pages.lead: Using the form in an answer

parts.text: Gdzie pracujesz? asks where you work. W biurze. is the natural short answer: the preposition w needs the locative form, not the dictionary form.

pages.title: The matching card
pages.lead: Form and meaning, side by side

parts.text: The five pairs are biuro office, biura of the office, biuru to the office, biurze in the office and biurem with the office.
Knowing a form and knowing its meaning are two different things. This card checks both at once.
